name: time_modes
rows: Clock time (standard time of your zone)

name: longitude_custom
expr: 3.73 deg

name: wall_declination
expr: 0 deg

name: dial_diameter
expr: 250 mm

name: sheet_thickness
expr: 3 mm

name: laser_kerf
expr: 0.1 mm

name: latitude
expr: if(place == 1, latitude_custom, places[place].latitude)

name: longitude
expr: if(place == 1, longitude_custom, places[place].longitude)

name: utc_offset
expr: if(place == 1, utc_offset_custom, places[place].utc_offset)

name: zone_meridian
expr: 15 deg * utc_offset

name: is_vertical
expr: dial_type == 2

name: declination
expr: if(is_vertical, wall_declination, 0 deg)

name: longitude_shift
expr: if(time_shown == 1, longitude - zone_meridian, 0 deg)

name: style_height
expr: if(is_vertical, asin(cos(latitude) * cos(declination)), latitude)

name: sin_style_height
expr: sin(style_height)

name: substyle_tilt
expr: if(is_vertical, atan(sin(declination) / tan(latitude)), 0 deg)

name: substyle_hour_angle
expr: if(is_vertical, atan(tan(declination) / sin(latitude)), 0 deg)

name: hour_shift
expr: longitude_shift - substyle_hour_angle

name: afternoon_side
expr: if(is_vertical, -1, 1)

name: sun_hour_limit
expr: min(acos(-tan(latitude) * tan(obliquity)), 135 deg)

name: declination_limit
expr: min(50 deg, acos(min(1, 0.35 / cos(latitude))))

name: dial_radius
expr: dial_diameter / 2

name: thickness_half
expr: sheet_thickness / 2

name: line_width
expr: clamp(0.004 * dial_diameter, 0.6 mm, 1.2 mm)

name: root_offset
expr: if(is_vertical, 0.45, 0.28 + 0.17 * clamp((135 deg - sun_hour_limit) / 35 deg, 0, 1)) * dial_radius

name: root_y
expr: -root_offset

name: outer_ring
expr: dial_radius - 0.03 * dial_diameter - line_width / 2

name: closest_lines
expr: atan(sin_style_height * tan(15 deg))

name: numeral_reach
expr: outer_ring - line_width + 2 * glyph_overlap + root_offset

name: numeral_height
expr: min(0.055 * dial_diameter, (numeral_reach * closest_lines / 1 rad - 2 * line_width) / (1.43 + closest_lines / 1 rad))

name: inner_ring
expr: outer_ring - numeral_height - line_width + 2 * glyph_overlap

name: numeral_up
expr: if(is_vertical, -1, 1)

name: numeral_base
expr: outer_ring - line_width / 2 + glyph_overlap - if(is_vertical, 0 mm, numeral_height)

name: ring_power
expr: thickness_half^2 + root_offset^2 - inner_ring^2

name: first_radius
expr: max(0.05 * dial_diameter, 2 * line_width / (closest_lines / 1 rad))

name: tick_length
expr: 0.045 * dial_diameter

name: park_step
expr: 3 * dial_diameter

name: keep_clear
expr: max(0.6 mm, line_width)

name: gnomon_length
expr: min(0.7 * (inner_ring + root_offset), 0.5 * dial_diameter / tan(style_height))

name: gnomon_height
expr: gnomon_length * tan(style_height)

name: gnomon_front
expr: min(max(0.06 * gnomon_length, sheet_thickness / tan(style_height)), 0.3 * gnomon_length)

name: back_arc
expr: min(0.4 * gnomon_length, 0.55 * gnomon_height)

name: foot_end
expr: gnomon_length - back_arc

name: tab_length
expr: clamp(0.22 * (foot_end - gnomon_front), 5 mm, 25 mm)

name: tab_first
expr: gnomon_front + 0.25 * (foot_end - gnomon_front)

name: tab_second
expr: gnomon_front + 0.75 * (foot_end - gnomon_front)

name: slot_play
expr: 0.2 mm

name: slot_width
expr: sheet_thickness + slot_play

name: slot_length
expr: tab_length + 2.5 * slot_play

name: tab_depth
expr: sheet_thickness - slot_play

name: beam_offset
expr: laser_kerf / 2

name: notch_radius
expr: max(2 mm, sheet_thickness / 2 + 0.5 mm)

name: notch_angle
expr: 2 * asin(notch_radius / (2 * dial_radius))

name: pair_angle
expr: asin(2 * notch_radius / dial_radius)

name: mark_reach
expr: dial_radius - notch_radius - 1 mm

name: hole_diameter
expr: if(sheet_thickness > 4.5 mm, 5.5 mm, 4.5 mm)

name: hole_distance
expr: clamp(0.45 * (inner_ring - root_offset), 18 mm, 40 mm)

name: hole_angle
expr: 25 deg

name: slate_half
expr: dial_radius + 0.06 * dial_diameter + 10 mm

name: slate_thickness
expr: if(is_vertical, 20 mm, 25 mm)

name: slate_bevel
expr: 4 mm

name: slate_hole_diameter
expr: 6.6 mm

name: slate_hole_inset
expr: 20 mm

name: plate_x_x
expr: if(is_vertical, -cos(substyle_tilt), 1)

name: plate_x_y
expr: if(is_vertical, sin(substyle_tilt), 0)

name: plate_y_x
expr: if(is_vertical, -sin(substyle_tilt), 0)

name: plate_y_y
expr: if(is_vertical, -cos(substyle_tilt), 1)

name: plate_up_angle
expr: atan2(plate_y_y, plate_y_x)

name: frame_x_x
expr: if(is_vertical, -cos(substyle_tilt), 1)

name: frame_x_z
expr: if(is_vertical, -sin(substyle_tilt), 0)

name: frame_y_x
expr: if(is_vertical, sin(substyle_tilt), 0)

name: frame_y_y
expr: if(is_vertical, 0, 1)

name: frame_y_z
expr: if(is_vertical, -cos(substyle_tilt), 0)

name: frame_z_y
expr: if(is_vertical, -1, 0)

name: frame_z_z
expr: if(is_vertical, 0, 1)

name: noon_hour
expr: 12 - hour_shift / 15 deg

name: twin_on
expr: abs(noon_hour - round(noon_hour)) < 1e-9 && round(noon_hour) >= 1 && round(noon_hour) <= 23 && abs(substyle_hour_angle) <= 135 deg + 1e-9 deg && max(-obliquity, atan2(sin(latitude), cos(latitude) * cos(substyle_hour_angle)) - 90 deg, if(is_vertical, atan2(-cos(latitude) * cos(declination), sin(substyle_hour_angle) * sin(declination) + cos(substyle_hour_angle) * sin(latitude) * cos(declination)), atan2(sin(latitude), cos(latitude) * cos(substyle_hour_angle))) - 90 deg) <= min(obliquity, atan2(sin(latitude), cos(latitude) * cos(substyle_hour_angle)) + 90 deg, if(is_vertical, atan2(-cos(latitude) * cos(declination), sin(substyle_hour_angle) * sin(declination) + cos(substyle_hour_angle) * sin(latitude) * cos(declination)), atan2(sin(latitude), cos(latitude) * cos(substyle_hour_angle))) + 90 deg) + 1e-9 deg

name: twin_reach
expr: root_offset + sqrt(root_offset^2 - ring_power)

name: hour_01_angle
expr: atan2(afternoon_side * sin_style_height * sin(15 deg * -11 + hour_shift), cos(15 deg * -11 + hour_shift))

name: hour_01_on
expr: abs((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift)) <= 135 deg + 1e-9 deg && max(-obliquity, atan2(sin(latitude), cos(latitude) * cos((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift))) - 90 deg, if(is_vertical, atan2(-cos(latitude) * cos(declination), sin((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift)) * sin(declination) + cos((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift)) * sin(latitude) * cos(declination)), atan2(sin(latitude), cos(latitude) * cos((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift)))) - 90 deg) <= min(obliquity, atan2(sin(latitude), cos(latitude) * cos((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift))) + 90 deg, if(is_vertical, atan2(-cos(latitude) * cos(declination), sin((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift)) * sin(declination) + cos((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift)) * sin(latitude) * cos(declination)), atan2(sin(latitude), cos(latitude) * cos((15 deg * -11 + longitude_shift)))) + 90 deg) + 1e-9 deg

name: hour_01_x
expr: if(hour_01_on, thickness_half * if(sin(2 * hour_01_angle) >= 0, 1, -1), park_step * 1)

name: hour_01_reach
expr: max(2 * first_radius, -(thickness_half * abs(sin(hour_01_angle)) * if(cos(hour_01_angle) >= 0, 1, -1) - root_offset * cos(hour_01_angle)) + sqrt((thickness_half * abs(sin(hour_01_angle)) * if(cos(hour_01_angle) >= 0, 1, -1) - root_offset * cos(hour_01_angle))^2 - ring_power))

name: hour_01_mark
expr: atan2(root_y + hour_01_reach * cos(hour_01_angle), hour_01_x * (1 - twin_on * (round(noon_hour) == 1)) + hour_01_reach * sin(hour_01_angle))

name: hour_01_base
expr: if(hour_01_on, numeral_base, park_step * 1)

name: place
label: Place
description: A city sets the latitude, longitude and time zone. Choose Custom to give your own below.

name: latitude_custom
label: Latitude (Custom)
description: Degrees north of the equator, 25 to 65. Southern places are not offered.

name: longitude_custom
label: Longitude (Custom)
description: Degrees east of Greenwich, west negative; at most 30 degrees from your time zone's meridian (15 degrees times its hours from UTC).

name: utc_offset_custom
label: Time zone, hours from UTC (Custom)
description: Your standard (winter) time: +1 for Central European Time, 0 for London, -5 for New York.

name: dial_type
label: Dial
description: A horizontal dial for a pedestal in the garden, or a vertical dial for a wall.

name: wall_declination
label: Wall direction, degrees west of south
description: Wall dial only: how far the wall's face turns from due south, west positive, east negative (a wall facing south-west: 45). Up to 50 degrees, less far north, where the gnomon would lie too flat and the lines too close.

name: time_shown
label: Time shown
description: Clock time: the lines are moved by the longitude correction, so the dial shows the standard time of your zone; add an hour in summer time, and the equation of time (the sun runs up to 16 minutes ahead or behind: add about 3 min on 1 Jan, 13 on 1 Feb, 13 on 1 Mar, 4 on 1 Apr, -3 on 1 May, -3 on 1 Jun, 4 on 1 Jul, 7 on 1 Aug, 0 on 1 Sep, -10 on 1 Oct, -16 on 1 Nov, -11 on 1 Dec). Local solar time: noon on the gnomon.

name: dial_diameter
label: Dial diameter
description: Diameter of the brass dial plate; the slate is 12 % and 20 mm larger.

name: sheet_thickness
label: Brass sheet
description: Dial plate and gnomon are cut from this sheet; at least 1 % of the diameter (a rule of thumb, so the gnomon stays stiff).

name: laser_kerf
label: Laser kerf
description: Width of your laser's cut, up to 0.2 mm. The parts are drawn as the beam's path: outlines half a kerf out, slots, holes and notches half a kerf in, so they come out at size; cut them with the laser's own kerf compensation off. A waterjet or any machine with a wider cut: set 0, so the Cut sheet is the parts' true outline, and switch the machine's own compensation on.

title: Sundial for your place
author: 3DCraft Jigs
description: A sundial for your place, in brass on slate: a horizontal dial for a pedestal or a vertical dial for a wall, also one that does not face south, anywhere from 25 to 65 degrees north. The hour lines follow the plane-dial formulas and are moved by the longitude correction, so the dial reads the standard time of your zone (the equation of time is in the description of Time shown); the gnomon is as thick as the sheet, so its two edges cast the morning and the afternoon lines from either side of a noon gap. Assertions rebuild the style and three hour lines from the shadow of the gnomon, worked out with vectors. To export: File > Export, Sheet of set Cut sheet (the dial plate and the gnomon, DXF or SVG: for a laser drawn as the beam's path for the kerf on the form; for a waterjet set the kerf to 0 and use the machine's compensation), and Sheet of set Engraving (one region: rings, hour lines, half-hour ticks, numerals and three index marks) for the engraver. In one engrave-and-cut job, place the Engraving's box the output Engraving inset inside the plate's box, from the left and the bottom; on a plate already cut, lay the index marks on the plate's three notches (two at the top, one at the right), which fit one way only.
